{{Top|leg|italics=1}}
The Imperial Nebulon-B frigate '''''Rapier''''' failed to destroy the Alliance Mon Calamari Star Cruiser ''[[Stimsenj'kat]]'' which was having cargo transferred from Transport Group [[Renhoek (transports)|''Renhoek'']] (made up of at least six Delta-class DX-9 stormtrooper transports). [[Keyan Farlander/Legends|Keyan Farlander]] and a few other rebels destroyed this frigate during the operation.
